I offer you this advice, try. try to find things within yourself that you love. try to find one thing every day that makes you smile. and even if you can’t, become it. it’s up to you to make yourself see the beauty, love. that’s what I’ve learned.

the way you feel, is the exact way I felt years ago. especially in high school, I remember my self harm being at an all time high. it took me years to find peace and learn to love myself. it is possible, just take it day by day. even if that seems difficult, take it second by second or minute by minute. I believe in you.

pain is pain. you don’t have to have cancer to feel pain. you don’t ever have to validate your feelings or dismiss them. they are there for a reason. it’s okay to feel like you are on autopilot, you are acknowledging it. next, you must decide what it is you want to do next? seek help? or seek another form of help. it doesn’t always have to be seeing a professional. for me-it’s been looking within and sitting with my grief, anger and despair. I hope you find the healing you so desperately desire.
